title: Carrier Pickup Event Fields
description: Fields a Fulfillment Event carries when it concerns a parcel sent to a carrier point. Deposit at the point (`ready_for_pickup`) and collection by the Buyer (`picked_up`) are separate events: deposit starts the holding period, collection is the moment the Buyer acquires physical possession.

point.title: Carrier Point Key
point.description: The carrier point the event concerns, by its point key. For `ready_for_pickup` after a redirect, the point where the parcel now waits.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the point.

pickup_by.description: RFC 3339 timestamp until which the parcel waits at `point`. A later `ready_for_pickup` event with a new `pickup_by` supersedes an earlier one (extension or redirect).
